worked_example.problem: A fire grows bigger, moves and uses air. Is fire a living thing?
steps: A fire does not reproduce young ones, has no sensitivity and does not excrete waste made in a body.
It does not show all seven characteristics.

cards.idea: Living things share seven characteristics: Movement, Respiration, Sensitivity, Growth, Reproduction, Excretion, Nutrition (MRS GREN).
example: A goat moves, breathes, feels, grows, has kids, excretes and eats.

cards.idea: Plants show them too: leaves turn to the light (movement, sensitivity), plants grow, make seeds and make their own food.
example: A bean seedling bends towards the window.

cards.idea: A thing is living only if it shows all seven characteristics.
example: A car moves but does not grow or reproduce: it is not living.

check.prompt: Which of these is a living thing?

wrong.explain: A car does not grow or reproduce.
A fire does not reproduce or excrete.
A stone shows none of the characteristics.

questions.prompt: Match each characteristic of living things with its meaning.

pool.right: moving the body or a part of it
noticing and responding to changes around
getting rid of waste made in the body

pick.t: A sunflower turns to face the sun.
pick.why: Sensitivity: A sunflower turns to face the sun.

pick.t: A hen lays eggs that hatch into chicks.
pick.why: Reproduction: A hen lays eggs that hatch into chicks.

pick.t: A baby becomes a child, then an adult.
pick.why: Growth: A baby becomes a child, then an adult.

pick.t: We breathe out carbon dioxide made in our cells.
pick.why: Excretion: We breathe out carbon dioxide made in our cells.

pick.t: A cell releases energy from sugar.
pick.why: Respiration: A cell releases energy from sugar.

pick.t: A lizard runs away from a cat.
pick.why: Movement: A lizard runs away from a cat.

questions.prompt:
Which characteristic of living things is shown?
{x.t}

misconceptions.explain: Not that one. Read MRS GREN again.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Excretion is getting rid of waste made in the body.

wrong.text: A car is living because it moves.
wrong.explain: A car does not grow or reproduce.
Green plants make their own food: that is nutrition.

wrong.text: Respiration is the same as breathing in air.
wrong.explain: Respiration releases energy from food in the cells; breathing moves air in and out.
